item.description:
Memophant 2.1.1

A stability release: a smoother, more responsive app and a more robust memory engine under heavy use.

Improved

  • Fewer hitches. The Sessions tier, Code Browser, drift checks, tier lists, repository scans, and previews now do their disk and database work off the main thread. Superseded Code Browser searches are cancelled.
  • Steadier under bursts of writes. Background follow-up work after each write is capped, so large batches commit several times faster.

Fixed

  • A slow, late result could appear in the wrong note or project after switching quickly.
  • The MCP tool-call timeout now fires, and calls arriving during a license unlock are no longer dropped.
  • Moving a memory while it was being edited could lose that edit; it is now kept, or the move fails cleanly.
  • Several rare search-index races that could briefly show stale results or mismatched embeddings.
  • The code auto-indexer starts and stops cleanly; overlapping project refreshes are merged, not dropped.
  • A failed model load could trigger a duplicate ~80 MB embedding-model download.
